entries.title: SIKH EMPIRE: AR rupee (10.45g), Lahore, VS1822
entries.description: SIKH EMPIRE: AR rupee (10.45g), Lahore, VS1822, KM-63, Herrli-08.02.04, terribly cleaned VF, R, ex Hakim Hamidi.    VS1822 (1765) was the year of Sikh conquest of Lahore from the Durranis. Herrli's type 02.04, struck only VS1822-1823, differs from the relatively common 08.03.04 by the arrangement and calligraphy of the inscriptions.

entries.title: SIKH EMPIRE: AE falus (10.38g), Peshawar, ND (ca. 1810-1830), A-A3253, ornate canopy within arch
entries.description:
SIKH EMPIRE: AE falus (10.38g), Peshawar, ND (ca. 1810-1830), A-A3253, ornate canopy within arch, reverse style identical to rupees dated circa AH1224-1246, pleasing Fine to VF, R, ex M. H. Mirza collection. 

No comprehensive study of 18th-19th century Peshawar copper coinage has been attempted.
